title: 5. Data Collection, Quality & Outliers
description: Assess data quality, detect anomalies, and handle outliers using the IQR method.

blocks.content:
### Assessing Data Quality & Detecting Outliers

An **outlier** is an observation that lies an abnormal distance from other values in a random sample. Outliers can skew model predictions significantly.

#### Interquartile Range (IQR) Method
- $Q1 = 25\text{th percentile}$
- $Q3 = 75\text{th percentile}$
- $IQR = Q3 - Q1$
- Lower Bound $= Q1 - 1.5 \times IQR$
- Upper Bound $= Q3 + 1.5 \times IQR$

![House Price Outliers Box Plot](/images/ml/chart_box_plot.png)

blocks.starterCode:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

prices = pd.Series([250, 270, 280, 300, 310, 320, 330, 340, 350, 950])
Q1 = prices.quantile(0.25)
Q3 = prices.quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
outliers = prices[(prices < lower_bound) | (prices > upper_bound)]
print(f'Lower Bound: {lower_bound}, Upper Bound: {upper_bound}')
print('Outliers detected:', outliers.values)
